pages.title: Sign-in page
pages.spec: A centred card titled 'Washable OTA' with the subtitle 'Firmware releases for the laundry kiosks.', a password field labelled 'Admin password', a (disabled, because the field is empty) 'Sign in' button and a small line 'Server: ota.example.com'. No error message.

pages.title: Sign-in page after a wrong password
pages.spec: The same sign-in card, now with a red/pink alert 'Wrong password' above the button, the password field still filled (dots), the button enabled.

pages.title: Overview tab
pages.spec: Top bar (logo, 'Washable OTA', 'server v2.0.0', Sign out) and a tab bar (Overview, Nodes with a pill like 6/8, Releases, Code & build, Kiosk preview, Activity) with Overview active. Four stat tiles: Nodes 8, Online 6, Need attention 2, Updates pending 1 (assigned-but-not-installed; numbers must be consistent with the Fleet list). A 'Fleet' card listing the problem nodes (Kost Mawar problem, Kampus Barat attention, Apartemen Hijau offline, Pasar Baru offline) with their issues, and a 'Kiosk OTA URL' card with the URL https://ota.example.com/ota/manifest.json, a Copy button and explanatory text.

pages.title: Nodes tab (fleet table)
pages.spec: A 'Nodes' card with version chips (e.g. '3x v1.1.0', '5x v1.2.0') and a table of 8 kiosks with columns Node, Status, Firmware, Update, Activity, Wi-Fi, Up, Last seen and a select-all checkbox. Rows (sorted by machine): Mesin 02, Warung Budi, Laundry Melati, Kost Mawar (Problem), Pasar Baru (Offline, '-> v1.2.0 pending'), Ruko Sentosa (Healthy, 'v1.2.0 installed'), Kampus Barat (Attention), Apartemen Hijau (Offline). Below the table an assign bar: '0 selected', a release dropdown, disabled 'Send to selected' and 'Cancel pending update' buttons and the note that nothing is sent to every kiosk at once. On a phone the table may scroll horizontally inside its card but the page itself must not.

pages.title: Node detail: healthy node
pages.spec: The nodes table plus, under it, a detail card for 'Warung Budi' with a green Healthy badge, two key/value lists (device id a1b2c3d4e5f6, machine 03, firmware v1.2.0, first seen, last contact, restarts; screen, activity 'wash cycle running', uptime, last reset, Wi-Fi signal, memory, relay controller, OTA client), a label input with 'Save label' and 'Forget node' buttons, and a 'Timeline' list of events with small coloured badges.

pages.title: Node detail: problem node
pages.spec: Detail card for 'Kost Mawar' with a red Problem badge and a yellow warning list of issues (relay controller not responding, weak Wi-Fi, low memory, restarted after task watchdog, last OTA check or install failed), key/value lists with 'not responding' for the relay controller, and a timeline containing red 'crash' / 'download-failed' badges.

pages.title: Nodes tab after sending a release to three ticked nodes, one of which is skipped
pages.spec: Three rows were ticked (Warung Budi, Kost Mawar, Kampus Barat) and v1.2.0 was sent. Expect a yellow alert like '2 assigned, 1 skipped - Warung Budi: runs 1.2.0; kiosks refuse to downgrade or reinstall'. Kost Mawar and Kampus Barat now show '-> v1.2.0 pending' in the Update column.

pages.title: Nodes tab with two nodes ticked and release v1.3.0 chosen
pages.spec: Rows Warung Budi and Laundry Melati ticked, the assign bar shows '2 selected', the dropdown shows v1.3.0, 'Send to selected' enabled.

pages.title: Nodes tab right after assigning v1.3.0 to two nodes
pages.spec: A green alert 'v1.3.0 assigned to 2 nodes. They pick it up on their next check.', the two nodes show '-> v1.3.0 pending', the selection is cleared.

pages.title: Releases tab
pages.spec: A 'Releases' card with a table (Version with notes, Assigned to as 'N nodes' / 'nobody' badges, Size, SHA-256 prefix, Min., Added, and buttons 'Send to nodes...', 'Download', 'Delete' (disabled while nodes are assigned)). Releases present: v1.2.0 and v1.1.0, plus v1.3.0 when the live build was part of the run. Below it an 'Upload firmware' card with a dashed drop zone.

pages.title: Releases tab with a valid firmware file picked for upload
pages.spec: The upload card shows the chosen file name and size, a list of green check marks (size within the OTA slot, ESP32 app image header, classic ESP32, checksum intact, 'Contains the OTA client, firmware version 1.4.0'), the SHA-256, Version v1.4.0 (disabled field), Minimum version 1.2.0, release notes text, and an enabled 'Upload' button.

pages.title: Releases tab with an invalid firmware file picked
pages.spec: A red cross item 'OTA client marker not found' among otherwise green checks, version field empty, 'Upload' button disabled (greyed).

pages.title: Code & build tab: editor
pages.spec: A 'Firmware source' card with a hint paragraph, a file list on the left (esp32-kiosk/src/ ... main.cpp selected, ..., version.h with a small orange dot meaning changed; shared/relay_proto/relay_proto.h) and a Monaco code editor showing main.cpp with syntax highlighting and line numbers, a toolbar ('Diff vs repo' checkbox, 'Revert file', 'Save (Ctrl+S)' disabled) and above it 'N file changed from the repo' with 'Download patch' / 'Reset all'. Below: a 'Build with PlatformIO' card with a 'Build firmware' button. The editor must be readable in dark theme (dark editor) and light theme (light editor). On a phone the file list stacks above the editor.

pages.title: Code & build tab while a build is running
pages.spec: The Build card shows a disabled 'Building...' button, a 'Build log' heading with a yellow 'Running...' badge and a Cancel button, and a dark log box streaming PlatformIO output ('Compiling .pio/build/...'). Taken in the middle of a real build.

pages.title: Code & build tab after a successful build
pages.spec: Build log badge 'Succeeded' (green) and below the log a result box: 'firmware.bin v1.3.0 <size> <sha prefix>', two inputs (release notes, minimum version), a primary button 'Add v1.3.0 to releases' and a 'Download .bin' button.

pages.title: Code & build tab: diff view of version.h
pages.spec: The 'Diff vs repo' checkbox is ticked and the editor shows an inline diff of esp32-kiosk/src/version.h: the old line #define FW_VERSION "1.1.0" removed (red) and the new "1.3.0" added (green).

pages.title: Kiosk preview tab before the first build
pages.spec: A 'Kiosk preview' card with a blue 'Build preview' button, an explanation paragraph, and a yellow notice 'No preview yet. Press Build preview ...'. No phone image.

pages.title: Kiosk preview tab: idle kiosk screen
pages.spec: A phone-like frame with the kiosk's idle screen (washable wordmark and logo, 'Cucian kotor? Gampang.', a 'Sentuh untuk mulai' button, dark blue theme), to its right a 'Jump to screen' list of buttons (about 32 kiosk pages), segmented controls Bahasa/English, Dark/Light, size 1x/1.5x/2x, 'Skip 5 min of the running cycle' and 'Restart kiosk' buttons, and the relay indicator row 1-8. On a phone the frame must scale down to fit (no horizontal overflow).

pages.title: Kiosk preview tab: payment (QRIS) page
pages.spec: Same layout as the idle preview but the kiosk shows the payment page with a QR code and amount / countdown.

pages.title: Kiosk preview tab: wash cycle running
pages.spec: The kiosk shows the running-cycle page (progress ring or bar, remaining time, wash programme). Relay indicator 2 should be highlighted (green) because the wash relay is on.

pages.title: Kiosk preview tab: English, light kiosk theme, service list
pages.spec: The kiosk shows the service list ('What would you like to do?', Wash / Dry cards) in English on a LIGHT kiosk theme; the Light and English segmented buttons are active.

pages.title: Activity tab
pages.spec: A 'Node timeline' card listing recent events across the fleet (node name in bold, a small badge such as crash / reboot / firmware / assigned / download / relay / activity, text), then a 'Requests' card with a filter (All / Checks / Downloads) and a table (When, Node, Event, Kiosk runs, Server offered, Result, Source IP) with made-up documentation IP addresses.

pages.title: Activity tab filtered to downloads
pages.spec: Same as the Activity tab, but the Requests table only lists 'Firmware download' rows with Complete / Interrupted result badges, and the 'Downloads' filter button is active.
